reference_sql:
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE) AS cohort_month,
       COUNT(*) AS accounts
FROM accounts
WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE)
alternatives:
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE) AS cohort_month, COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS accounts
FROM accounts
WHERE date_part('year', created_at) IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY 1

SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', event_date) AS DATE) AS cohort_month, COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS accounts
FROM subscription_events
WHERE event_type = 'new'
GROUP BY 1

other_way.sql:
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', event_date) AS DATE) AS cohort_month, COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS accounts
FROM subscription_events
WHERE event_type = 'new'
GROUP BY 1
other_way.tradeoff: Counting each account's new event gives the same cohorts here, but it trusts that every new account has exactly one new event.
